_notice: FICTITIOUS. Operating rules for text messaging, patient outreach campaigns, HCP email and the HCP portal, for a support program and product that do not exist. Keyword lists and quiet hours follow common US practice for this pack; they are not legal advice.
applies_to: Every automated text QuorvantaConnect sends a patient, the patient outreach campaigns in campaigns.json, representative-triggered approved emails to prescribers, and the HCP portal. Phone calls by case managers and nurses are governed by patient-services/conversation-rules.json.

consents.allows: The activation text (MSG-ACT-01) and program email. It does not by itself allow any other text.

consents.source: A YES reply to the activation text (double opt-in)
consents.allows: Campaign texts and keyword replies. Ends at the first opt-out keyword and starts again at the next opt-in keyword.

consents.source: Start Form C5, Blood test and refill reminders by text
consents.allows: Refill reminder texts (MSG-REM-REFILL), in addition to CNS-TEXT-OPTIN.

consents.source: The prescriber's approved-email consent in the CRM (consent.approved_email)
consents.allows: Approved representative emails (crm/approved-emails.json). Ends at an unsubscribe.

keywords.match: The whole inbound message, trimmed and compared without regard to case or accents, is one of these words. Anything else is free text.

time_zones.basis: The patient's state of residence. A state that spans two zones uses the zone of most of its population; the pack does not look up ZIP codes.

rules.title: Consent before any text
rules.rule: The activation text goes only to an adult patient with CNS-CONTACT on file. Every other outbound text, except a reply to a keyword, needs CNS-TEXT-OPTIN in force at the moment it is sent.

rules.title: Reminders need the reminder choice
rules.rule: Refill reminder texts also need CNS-TEXT-REMINDERS.

rules.title: Opt-out is immediate
rules.rule: An opt-out keyword ends all texts at once. The only text after it is one opt-out confirmation (MSG-STOP), sent in reply. A later opt-in keyword starts texts again with a confirmation (MSG-ACT-02).

rules.title: Keyword replies
rules.rule: An opt-in keyword gets MSG-ACT-02, an opt-out keyword gets MSG-STOP, a help keyword gets MSG-HELP whatever the opt-in state, and free text from an opted-in patient gets MSG-REPLY-RECEIVED. Each reply is sent within 2 minutes, in the patient's language, and is exempt from quiet hours and the frequency cap. Free text is routed to the case manager; free text that mentions a possible side effect is also forwarded to Drug Safety the same day, and its receipt is day 0 (safety/safety-reference.json).

rules.title: Quiet hours
rules.rule: Texts other than keyword replies are sent only between 8 a.m. and 9 p.m. in the patient's local time (time_zones).

rules.title: Frequency cap
rules.rule: A patient receives at most 2 campaign texts (CMP-NEVERSTART and CMP-DISCON-RISK together) in any 7 consecutive days. Activation, reminder and keyword texts do not count.

rules.title: Language
rules.rule: Texts are sent in the patient's language when an approved version exists (English and Spanish). A patient who speaks another language gets no automated texts; the case manager calls with an interpreter.

rules.title: Approved wording only
rules.rule: Every outbound text is an approved message from approved-messages.json, word for word, in the patient's language. Texts identify the sender as QuorvantaConnect and never name QUORVANTA or Brennick syndrome, a dose, a symptom, or any detail of the patient's case.

rules.title: Adults only
rules.rule: No text goes to a patient under 18.

rules.title: Stop when the situation ends
rules.rule: A never-start text is not sent once the first fill has shipped or the prescriber has canceled the prescription. A discontinuation-risk text or refill reminder is not sent once treatment has been discontinued. No campaign asks a patient to start again, continue, or restart treatment; those are decisions for the patient and their healthcare provider.

rules.title: Copay messages to commercial insurance only
rules.rule: MSG-NS-COST-COMMERCIAL, which mentions the copay program, goes only to patients with commercial insurance and no government program. Everyone else gets MSG-NS-COST-OTHER.

rules.title: Approved emails to consenting prescribers
rules.rule: A representative sends an approved email only from a template in crm/approved-emails.json, to an active prescriber with CNS-HCP-EMAIL in force, in the representative's own territory. An unsubscribe ends the consent at once.

rules.title: Machine activity is not engagement
rules.rule: An open recorded within 5 seconds of delivery is a privacy-proxy prefetch, and a click recorded within 10 seconds of delivery and before any human open is a security scanner. Neither counts as engagement or as a signal for next-best-action.
